reviewNotes: ADMIT-BACKSTAGE. csl currently lists HK Mobi 365-day prepaid products with no administration fee and a recharge table where HKD20/50/100 extends card validity 365 days; the current HKD20 renewal mechanic is explicitly promotional through 31 Dec 2026. csl requires real-name registration before use. Long-running HKEPC user evidence corroborates HKD20/365-day renewal and 2025-2026 eSIM/MNP operation. Reverify the recharge rule after the promotion date; do not infer universal mainland-China OTP reliability.

events.outcome: Current csl HK Mobi page gives 365-day card validity and a promotional HKD20-or-more recharge ladder extending card validity by 365 days through 31 Dec 2026. csl also requires real-name registration; long-running community evidence corroborates the HKD20 annual renewal mechanic and current eSIM/MNP use.

data.acquisitionSummary: HK Mobi is a distinct csl prepaid family. Current provider pages list 365-day variants; real-name registration is required before use. Community users document MNP and eSIM handling, but eSIM availability/process can depend on current service channels.

keep.action: Recharge HKD20 or more. Current csl HK Mobi recharge table extends card validity 365 days from the top-up date; the published HKD20/365-day recharge promotion is stated through 31 Dec 2026 and must be reverified after that date.

data.chinaActivation: Real-name registration is required before use. Provider supports international roaming products including mainland China, but a universal mainland-China-first activation path is not established in this review.
data.kyc: csl states real-name registration is required before use for dealer prepaid SIMs including HK Mobi.
data.payment: csl prepaid top-up supports vouchers and online payment methods; community users also document online/account top-up paths.
data.roamingSms: Provider offers roaming functionality and community users use HK Mobi for long-term number retention, but mainland-China incoming-SMS and third-party OTP reliability are not normalized as guarantees here.
data.tariffSummary: Current HK Mobi 365-day prepaid; HKD20 top-up extends card validity 365 days under the published promotion through 31 Dec 2026. Real-name registration required.
guideSteps: Acquire a current HK Mobi 365-day variant and complete real-name registration.
Before expiry, recharge at least HKD20 while the current 365-day promotion is live and verify the new expiry date.
Recheck the provider recharge table after 31 Dec 2026 before relying on HKD20 as the annual keep cost.
